nodes.description: A patent publication titled "Social medical network for diagnosis assistance" describing a method for diagnosis assistance using similarity between medical cases and experts in a common embedding space.

nodes.entity_id: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance
nodes.description: The title of the patent describing a method for diagnosis assistance that exploits similarity between a new medical case and existing medical cases and experts.
nodes.id: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance

nodes.description: A method that receives a query request including a new medical case, embeds the new case in an embedding space with existing medical cases and experts, and returns subsets of cases or experts based on computed similarity.

A common space in which a new medical case, a set of existing medical cases, and a set of experts are embedded as multidimensional representations.<SEP>A multidimensional space in which existing medical cases, experts, and new medical cases are embedded as multidimensional representations.

A medical case submitted by a requester as part of a query request, which is embedded in the embedding space for comparison with existing cases and experts.<SEP>A case comprising a plurality of records relating to a specific patient, received in a query request and embedded in the embedding space for diagnosis assistance.

A set of previously known medical cases embedded in the embedding space, used as candidates returned in a query-for-cases.<SEP>A set of medical cases that are embedded in the embedding space and compared against a new medical case via a computed similarity.

A set of experts embedded in the embedding space, used as candidates returned in a query-for-experts to attempt to provide a diagnosis.<SEP>A set of experts each embedded in the embedding space based on information such as expert profiles, coded medical procedures performed, authored articles, and linked stored medical cases.
The party submitting a query request including a new medical case and selecting from a plurality of query types.<SEP>A user who submits a request for a query including a new medical case.

A query type that, when selected, returns a subset of existing cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.<SEP>A query type that returns a subset of existing cases based on a computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.

A query type that, when selected, returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.<SEP>A query type that returns a subset of experts based on a computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.

A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from and is higher than the cost for a query-for-cases.<SEP>A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts is different from (higher than) the cost for a query-for-cases.

A set of medical concepts joined by links, each corresponding to a dimension in the multidimensional representation, used as the basis for embedding cases and experts.<SEP>An ontology that includes parts of the human body, biological functions, medical conditions, pharmacological substances, and combinations thereof, and may be based on the Unified Medical Language System.
Concepts within the medical ontology joined by links, each corresponding to a respective dimension in the representation.
A representation of a medical case computed based on a medical ontology, used for embedding in the embedding space.

A matrix applied to the multidimensional representation of the new case that accounts for relationships between concepts in the ontology when computing similarity measures.<SEP>A matrix applied to the multidimensional representation of the new case that accounts for relationships between concepts in the ontology.
A processor that performs at least one of the embedding, providing, returning subsets, and computing the query cost.
Parts of the human body included in the ontology.
Biological functions included in the ontology.
Medical conditions included in the ontology.
Pharmacological substances included in the ontology.
A medical ontology system on which the medical ontology used in the method is based.

A computation between the representation of the new case and representations of existing cases or experts, applying a matrix of proximities to the multidimensional representation of the new case that accounts for relationships between concepts in the ontology.
A medical determination formulated by a selected expert to whom the new case is provided.
A payment made to an expert for formulating a diagnosis.

A plurality of records relating to a specific patient, including laboratory test results, images, descriptions of symptoms, results of patient monitors, diagnoses, prescribed medications and treatments, and combinations thereof.

A system comprising memory storing instructions and a processor for executing them, for receiving query requests, embedding new medical cases, providing query type selection, and returning subsets of cases or experts.
A network comprising a diagnosis assistance system and a set of user devices for linking requesters and experts with the system.
A set of devices in the network for linking requesters and experts with the diagnosis assistance system.
A product comprising a non-transitory recording medium storing instructions that when executed on a computer cause the computer to perform the diagnosis assistance method.
A database from which documents are returned based on a computed similarity between the embedded new case and documents embedded in the embedding space.
